closing.summary: Big strengths are protein, omega 3, and vitamin B12, but the biggest weaknesses are low zinc, low vitamin D, and cost and storage can be a pain. It is good for muscles and strength sports, blood and oxygen support, and hormone health because the protein section supports repair and maintenance, vitamin B12 supports the blood-and-oxygen side, and the fat section has enough useful fats for a support role.
